title: Reader accounts: signed-in readers per publication
description:
Signed-in readers for a publication, so that votes, submissions and comments can be attributed. Guests still read everything. Optional per publication; editors-only remains the default for every existing site.

Context: today only staff sign in (Google). No reader identity exists. Prospectus accounts integration is in progress for another consumer (PPY-58f107); reuse it, do not fork it. Standing rule: Google sign-in only; never create password users.

Parent initiative: PPY-77bb3b (milestone 2). Pilot: Shipped (ship-b35fa2).

Children: Google reader sign-in; public handle and profile.
Definition of Done: a guest can sign in as a reader on a pilot site, pick a handle, and sign out; staff permissions are unchanged.
